INPUTS = {'deploy/services.tsv': 'service\tdepends\nsmoke\tweb,admin,receipts,alerts\nalerts\tmetrics,mailer\nmetrics\tconfig\nadmin\tauth,catalog\nweb\tcheckout,cdn\nreceipts\tcheckout,mailer\nmailer\tconfig\ncheckout\tauth,pricing,catalog\npricing\tschema,config\ncatalog\tschema,cache\nauth\tschema,config\ncdn\tassets\nconfig\tsecrets\nschema\tdatabase\ncache\t-\nsecrets\t-\ndatabase\t-\nassets\t-\n'}
import json, hashlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts/plan_deployment.sh'
BASE = len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'base'
def put(p, text):
    p = root / p
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
def get(p):
    return (root / p).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
def tree(p):
    base = root / p
    return {str(f.relative_to(base)): f.read_bytes().decode('utf-8') for f in base.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
def run(*args, code=0):
    run.calls = getattr(run, 'calls', 0) + 1
    relative = run.calls % 2 == 0
    actual = [str(value) if relative or not (i in (0, 1)) else str(root / str(value)) for i, value in enumerate(args)]
    r = subprocess.run(['bash', str(SCRIPT), *actual], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    assert r.returncode == code, (args, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
    return r
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ops-check-') as temporary:

INPUT is TSV with service/depends headers; service names are unique ASCII lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. depends is `-` for none, otherwise a comma-separated list of distinct service names. In each step select ALL remaining services whose dependencies completed in PREVIOUS steps, sort this batch in ASCII order, then mark the whole batch complete. OUTPUT has `step<TAB>services` header and one row per step starting at 1; services are comma-joined with no spaces. An empty input produces only the header. If a dependency is unknown, or any cycle exists (including a self-dependency), exit 2 and leave an existing OUTPUT byte for byte unchanged, or keep it absent if it did not exist. Validate the whole plan before writing any output, even if some earlier batches were possible. Successful runs exit 0 and create output parents. INPUT and OUTPUT differ; input stays unchanged. deploy/services.tsv lists the current services.
Work in /app. Write `scripts/plan_deployment.sh` and run `python3 tests/check_plan_deployment.py`. The tests/ checker is protected; do not edit it. Keep input files unchanged. Accept arbitrary argument paths, including spaces; do not hardcode sample results. Available: bash, coreutils and the python3 standard library. No network, git, jq, curl or gawk.
